needed.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing on the right side to improve safety for pedestrians crossing the busy street.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the wide road to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to assist wheelchair users and those with mobility aids in safely crossing the road.
Install street lighting on the left side of the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
